notes: Candidates: paths with >=1 feasible non-void run, grouped by project and number of stages. Objective values are means over FEASIBLE runs (src.routing.outcomes.aggregate_runs). Quality metrics are maximised except unsupported_claim_count (minimised); end_to_end_ms and total_tokens minimised; cost only when verified for every candidate. No composite score. 'no_feasible_path' rows are kept.
